meta.name: Reunited Worlds
meta.description:
Although born in the same year, two childhood friends end up being 13 years apart because they have aged surprisingly at different places (worlds) for some strange reason. Now Eom Hyeon Soo is a 31-year-old woman but Sung Hae Sung is still a 18-year-old boy. Cha Won Yooung is a chef also interested in Eom Hyeon Soo.

Ended · First aired 19 Jul 2017 · South Korea · Language: Korean · 30 min
Studio: IMTV · Network: SBS

Not complete. On your server: S1 20/40 (missing E21-40)

On your server — Audio: Hindi, Korean (from file names)

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Hae Sung and Jung Won are ordinary high school seniors who are getting themselves ready for life after graduation. One day, Hae Sung wakes up to find everything surrounding him different. He was dead for 12 years.

videos.title: The Accident
videos.overview: Hae Sung looks for ways to figure out what happened to him when he accidentally runs into his high school friend, Ho Bang. Ho Bang visits Hae Sung's tomb every year with the rest of Hae Sung's high school friends. It turns out that Hae Sung was killed on his birthday.

videos.title: How Is He Alive?
videos.overview: Jung Won is confused and pressured by Min Joon's confession. Hae Sung finds out how his family and friends have been living through Ho Bang, who also tells him that he and the rest of their friends lost touch with Jung Won.

videos.title: Endless Confusion
videos.overview: Jung Won takes care of Hae Sung who was injured and lost consciousness. Jung Won thinks she's insane for thinking that Hae Sung has comeback from death. Hae Sung finds out how Jung Won's life has been difficult without him and is heart-broken.

videos.title: Figuring Out the Present
videos.overview: Jung Won decides to let Hae Sung stay at her place. They spend a good time chatting about their past. The next day, Hae Sung finds a way to help both Jung Won and Hae Chul out of the gang's hands. Meanwhile, Hae Sung runs into Young Jun, but Young Jun asks her to keep his family status a secret.

videos.title: Putting the Pieces Back Together
videos.overview: Jung Won tells Min Joon that Hae Sung is her cousin, which doesn't make Hae Sung happy. On their way back home, Hae Sung and Jung Won decide to have a drink together for the first time. Hae Sung honestly tells Jung Won about how he feels about the current situation he is in.

videos.title: In His Place
videos.overview: Hae Sung finds out from Jung Won that Young Jun wasn't with her on the day Hae Sung died. The police report was recorded falsely and Hae Sung thinks it's strange. Meanwhile, Tae Hoon, who is the vice president of a department store, tells Hae Sung that Young In works in the department store. Hae Sung meets Young In, only to find out that she's been living a hard life.

videos.title: The Meaning of Family
videos.overview: Min Joon gets his wrist injured and Jung Won offers to help him. Hae Sung goes over to Min Joon's place and offers to help instead of Jung Won. Meanwhile, Gong Joo disappears from her kindergarten and Hae Chan looks all over the city to find her.

videos.title: You Are Not My Brother
videos.overview: Hae Sung finally meets his youngest sibling, Soo ji. He has met all of them and had a chance to talk to each other except for Young Jun. When Hae Sung visits Young Jun at his hospital to talk, Young Jun tells him to stop acting like his real brother.

videos.title: Living Your Dream
videos.overview: Min Joon helps and trains Jung Won into becoming the main chef of his restaurant. However, Jung Won fails the promotion test and does not make it. Disappointed Jung Won meets up with Hae Sung in front of the restaurant and hugs him, only to be discovered by Min Joon.

videos.title: Who Killed Hae Sung?
videos.overview: Ho Bang tells Hae Sung that the driver who hit Hae Sung with his car was also dead. When Ho Bang visited the driver's funeral home, the driver's wife was saying that he wasn't the real killer, which made Ho Bang suspicious. Ho Bang gets transferred to Seoul and the friends gather to send him off.

videos.title: The Fireworks
videos.overview: Hae Sung finds out that Hae Chul got into a fight in the restaurant because someone accused Hae Sung of being a murderer. Mr. Ahn tells Hae Sung that he gets pain in his chest whenever he's near someone who's related to his death. Min Joon gets hit by a car while trying to help Jung Won.

videos.title: Taking a Hint
videos.overview: Jung Won gets held up at a hospital because of Min Joon's accident. Fortunately, she makes it to the fireworks festival and meets up with Hae Sung there. Hae Sung feels another pain in the chest and looks for people who might be related to his death.

videos.title: The Meaning of Family
videos.overview: Hae Sung and Jung Won have a drink at her place when all of their friends show up and catch them. Meanwhile, Hae Sung tries to convince his sisters, Young In and Soo Ji, to straighten things with their brother Hae Chul, and they all have a meal together.

videos.title: Hae Sung's Chest Pain Continues
videos.overview: Hae Sung gets saddened by the fact that he has to return when his time comes. However, he decides to make the most of his time and looks for the person who murdered him. Ho Bang helps Hae Sung by questioning Tae Hoon's father whose driver was accused as the murderer. Meanwhile, Min Joon asks his kitchen staff to come up with a new menu for the restaurant.

videos.title: The New Job
videos.overview: Hae Sung applies for a position at Min Joon's restaurant and he has to come up with a new menu to pass the test. Meanwhile, Seo Won visits Min Joon's restaurant with her colleague who used to go to the high school that Jung Won went to. Min Joon learns that Jung Won suffered a lot because her boyfriend died in high school.

videos.title: The Guilt
videos.overview: Jung Won acts awkward in front of Hae Sung because she was reminded of the time she suffered because of his death. She feels guilty as she thinks it's all her fault that things turned out the way they are. Meanwhile, Min Joon confesses to Hae Sung that he likes Jung Won.

videos.title: The Culprit in the Room
videos.overview: Hae Sung and Jung Won find out how they feel about each other and kiss for the first time. They go on a trip together and make memories that they couldn't have over the past years. Meanwhile, Hae Sung caters for Chung Ho Foundation and feels immense pain in the chest.

videos.title: Why Did You Kill Me?
videos.overview: Hae Sung faces the culprit who's been causing a pain in his chest. It turns out to be Tae Hoon's father, Gwon Pyo. Gwon Pyo feels pressured as Hae Sung and Ho Bang are narrowing down on him. Meanwhile, Soo Ji's condition doesn't get better and she still hesitates to tell Young In about it.

videos.title: You Don't Have Evidence
videos.overview: Gong Ju's mother visits Hae Chul, but Hae Chul tells her to leave them alone. Min Joon's uncle turns out to be the driver who is known as the culprit, and Min Joon has the evidence to prove that his uncle did not kill Hae Sung.
